name: SelfDriven Science AI Resource Catalogue
description: Public research specifications and AI instruction resources published by SelfDriven Foundation.

resources.name: CBR-OEN Research
resources.description: Design, specify, review, govern, analyse, and extend the Compute-Based Reality Open Experimental Network as a falsifiable, preregistered, reproducible, and adversarial research programme.

invocation.suggested_prompt: Use the CBR-OEN Research skill to design, review, govern, or extend the experimental programme while preserving dependency gates, adversarial controls, reproducibility, evidence provenance, and conservative GO/REVISE/STOP decisions.

scientific_posture.founding_principle: CBR-OEN does not exist to prove Compute-Based Reality. It exists to make Compute-Based Reality testable.

a2a.note: This catalogue describes static AI-usable research resources. It does not advertise an A2A service endpoint.
